main.title: Orientation for the Reasonably Alarmed
main.detail: Report to Rowan Bramble and complete the Department of Mild Peril's beginner trail expedition. It is mostly walking, with forms.
main.quote: Danger is just nature wearing an unofficial hat.

main.title: The Rabbit Procedure
main.detail: Craft a basic spear at a workbench, then track two rabbits beyond the village paths.
main.quote: If it zigzags, stay calm. If you zigzag, call it fieldcraft.

main.title: Rarely Served Rare
main.detail: Turn fresh game into cooked meat at a campfire, then eat a portion to prove the recipe is legally supper.
main.quote: If it is still making eye contact, give it another minute.

main.title: Tea and Mild Sympathy
main.short: Improve the fire and brew berry tea
main.detail: Upgrade a campfire to level two, combine wild berries and herbs into berry tea, then have a drink.
main.quote: It tastes like courage remembering it left the kettle on.

main.title: A Desk for the Wilderness
main.detail: Upgrade a workbench to level two, tan leather, twist rope, improve the canteen, and reach two survived days.
main.quote: Survival begins with water and ends with a surprisingly detailed receipt.

main.title: Certified Field Kitchen
main.detail: Use the level two campfire to prepare two roasts and two restorative broths.
main.quote: An upgraded fire is exactly like fire, but with paperwork nearby.

main.title: A Pointed Policy
main.detail: Bring the hunting spear to level two. Keep the point toward the wilderness.
main.quote: The pointy end is policy. The other end is procedure.

main.title: A Rapid Rabbit Census
main.detail: Bring the career rabbit count to six and sample the cooked-meat reserves on patrol.
main.quote: The rabbits declined to complete their census forms.

main.title: Calling Their Bluff
main.short: Find Boar Bluff and hunt boars
main.detail: Locate Boar Bluff and deal with three boars who mistook the trail signs for a buffet.
main.quote: A boar is a pig with confidence and worse meeting etiquette.

main.title: Oh Deer, A Department
main.detail: Track three deer without being distracted by their superior posture.
main.quote: They heard you coming yesterday. Try apologizing to fewer twigs.

main.title: Leather Weather
main.short: Tan leather and improve your boots
main.detail: Bring the leather total to six and upgrade your boots for trails that have become personally muddy.
main.quote: Good boots keep the ground at a respectful distance.

main.title: Licensed to Lunch
main.detail: Cook six career portions of meat and complete a hunter expedition. Friends may join, but the permit is valid for one.
main.quote: Bring company if you like. The bushes remain unimpressed either way.

main.title: The Picnic That Time Forgot
main.detail: Discover the Picnic Ruins and recover two treasures without trusting the ancient sandwiches.
main.quote: History is written by the victors. Lunch is wrapped in wax paper.

main.title: A Steely Department
main.short: Upgrade the forge and make steel
main.detail: Upgrade the forge to level two and produce eight steel before attempting masterwork stations.
main.quote: Steel is iron that attended a very intense seminar.

main.title: Smoke Signals in Triplicate
main.short: Master the campfire and make jerky
main.detail: Use steel and leather to upgrade a campfire to level three, then smoke three strips of jerky.
main.quote: Lunch now has a longer shelf life than most committees.

main.title: The Broth Authority
main.short: Upgrade the tavern and simmer broth
main.detail: Upgrade the tavern to level two and bring the career broth total to four bowls.
main.quote: Soup is tea that has accepted additional responsibilities.

main.title: Taste Testing Is Work
main.detail: Bring the roast total to four, eat two roasts, brew six berry teas, and log five drinks.
main.quote: Quality control is just seconds with a clipboard.

main.title: Bench Press Release
main.detail: Upgrade the workbench to level three and bring the career rope total to twelve before assembling machinery.
main.quote: This bench now has more qualifications than the mayor.

main.title: Machinery, Probably
main.short: Upgrade the kiln and assemble machinery
main.detail: Upgrade the kiln to level two, then use the master workbench to assemble four clockwork parts.
main.quote: If it spins, it is machinery. If it flies away, update the form.

main.title: Meals on Heels
main.short: Pack rations and complete a chef expedition
main.detail: Use the master workbench and smoked jerky to craft eight career trail rations, then complete a chef expedition.
main.quote: Outdoor dining is indoor dining with more wind in the napkins.

main.title: Cut and Dig Bureau
main.detail: Upgrade the axe and pickaxe to level two for the Department's sturdier obstacles.
main.quote: One tool makes fewer trees. The other makes more holes.

main.title: Hydration with Confidence
main.short: Master the canteen and endure four days
main.detail: Use the master workbench and clockwork parts to upgrade the canteen to level three, then reach four survived days.
main.quote: Water is the traditional cure for accidentally becoming a raisin.

main.title: Sharper Than the Forms
main.detail: Raise both frontier tools to level three using steel, leather, and clockwork parts.
main.quote: A sharp tool saves time. A sharp form creates more forms.

main.title: Constructive Criticism
main.short: Upgrade the shed and lead a build
main.detail: Upgrade a shed to level two and complete a builder expedition. A crew is welcome, never required.
main.quote: Measure twice, build once, describe the wobble as rustic.

main.title: Camp, Abandoned
main.detail: Locate the Old Camp and raise the treasure tally to three. The cold kettle is not treasure.
main.quote: Someone left in a hurry, but alphabetized the firewood first.

main.title: The Falls Have Ears
main.detail: Find Whisper Falls and investigate why it sounds like someone reading minutes from a meeting.
main.quote: The waterfall whispers. Mostly it says splash, but with conviction.

main.title: A Reflection on Tea
main.detail: Find Moon Pond and bring the career refreshment count to eight. Do not drink directly from astronomy.
main.quote: The moon looks lovely in the pond and terrible in a canteen.

main.title: Cove Operations
main.detail: Discover Smugglers' Cove and recover six career treasures without adopting a cursed barrel.
main.quote: Everything here is legal if you squint at the paperwork.

main.title: Moss Definitely Grows Here
main.detail: Find Moss Cave and complete a forager expedition through its extremely committed greenery.
main.quote: The cave is damp, dark, and winning several gardening awards.

main.title: The Map Is Mostly Correct
main.detail: Complete an explorer expedition and bring the treasure record to eight discoveries. Solo maps are free.
main.quote: A blank patch on a map is just adventure with poor handwriting.

main.title: Sure Footing, Sharp Point
main.detail: Upgrade boots and spear to level three, then reach seven survived frontier days.
main.quote: Preparedness is confidence with better soles.

main.title: Peril, but Comfortable
main.detail: Upgrade a cottage and well to level two. Survival is nicer with a roof and fewer bucket errands.
main.quote: Comfort is danger observed through a properly glazed window.

main.title: Advanced Hospitality
main.detail: Upgrade the greenhouse to level two and the tavern to level three for year-round hospitality.
main.quote: Grow the herbs upstairs. Tell the stories downstairs.

main.title: Industrial Mildness
main.detail: Upgrade the forge and kiln to level three and bring the career machinery total to eight.
main.quote: The workshop now hums. We asked it to use an indoor voice.

main.title: The Highest Filing Cabinet
main.detail: Discover Star Summit and complete three career trail expeditions. Companions are welcome; solitude is certified.
main.quote: The view is breathtaking. The climb has already taken credit.

main.title: Permit to Thrive
main.detail: Raise a cottage to level three, reach ten survived days, and log ten treasures.
main.quote: Congratulations. You are licensed to encounter danger at your own sensible pace.

contracts.title: Rabbit Ledger Reconciliation
contracts.description: Turn in field samples after the rabbits refuse to sign the ledger.

contracts.title: Trail Mix-Up
contracts.description: Supply rope and steel for a bridge Rowan describes as mostly theoretical.

contracts.title: Berry Official Business
contracts.description: Provide berries and herbs for a survey that looks remarkably like tea.

contracts.title: Seasoned Judgment
contracts.description: Restock Petal's pantry before the herbs become academically wilted.

contracts.title: The Long Chew
contracts.description: Pack jerky for a patrol whose route was designed by someone already eating.

contracts.title: Hide and Receipt
contracts.description: Ember needs leather for protective aprons and one formal tool belt.

contracts.title: Broth of Confidence
contracts.description: Deliver broth and cooked meat to a field office pretending not to be cold.

contracts.title: Roast in Show
contracts.description: Stock the tavern supper before Mayor Honk volunteers as tester.

contracts.title: Parts Unknown
contracts.description: Supply machinery and steel for a device Ember has named Later.

contracts.title: A Taut Situation
contracts.description: Captain Minnow needs leather and rope for expedition rigging.

contracts.title: Ancient Change
contracts.description: Loan ancient coins for rubbings. Puddlewick returns the history attached.

contracts.title: Peak Provisions
contracts.description: Prepare rations and tea for climbers who mistook optimism for breakfast.

actNames: Tools of the Mildly Dangerous Trade
